:::: case-study-section
::: section-label
ABOUT THE PROJECT
:::

<h2 class="case-study-title">

Revisiting a franchise isn't enough.

</h2>

<p>This entertainment marketing project looks into the strategy behind legacy sequels: films that return to established franchises years or decades after the original.</p>

<p>Using <em>Top Gun: Maverick</em> as a golden example, I explored how nostalgia can attract existing fans while a film still needs to provide something new for modern audiences.</p>

<p>This project also compares other franchise revivals to identify how audience expectations, returning characters, branding, and marketing can influence reception.</p>
